context: During shutdown cleanup, two root-level directories found: Calendar/ and zzPlaud/. David clarified both are mistakes that need cleanup.
what_went_wrong: Calendar/ was created but never properly filed or used (contains single 2026-09-08.md note). zzPlaud/ was used as a staging area for transcript files that should have gone directly to Obsidian, then left orphaned without cleanup.
impact: Root directory cluttered with non-canonical entries. zzPlaud/ in particular represents incomplete workflow (files in wrong place, no cleanup on completion).
proposed_fix: Delete both Calendar/ and zzPlaud/ directories entirely. Update canonical file-map and gitignore to prevent root-level exceptions like this in future. Review workflows that create intermediate staging areas to ensure they have explicit cleanup steps.
notes: zzPlaud error represents a broader pattern: incomplete workflows that leave intermediate artifacts behind without cleanup. Should add cleanup validation to workflow completion gates.
